style.styleTitle: Decoris Set of 2 Hot Chocolate Mouse Decorations
style.toneOfVoice: <p>Evoke the warmth of a winter's evening with these handmade wool ornaments featuring a delightful ''mouse in a cup'' scene. The soft textile construction and unique handmade details give each of the two mice an individual character, creating a playful addition to your Tree. These charming figures provide a heartwarming visual that complements a variety of festive themes.</p><ul><li>Material: soft wool for a warm textile look&nbsp;<br></li><li>Dimensions: approximately 7 cm long, 10 cm wide and 13 cm high&nbsp;<br></li><li>Handmade construction for unique detailing&nbsp;</li></ul>
style.toneOfVoiceUnformatted: This Decoris mouse ornament is designed to hang in the Christmas tree and adds a playful touch to festive decorating. The wool figure creates a soft, warm look that fits well with a winter atmosphere. Handmade details give each mouse its own character, so the decoration stands out among baubles and lights. Different colour variants bring extra variety to the tree and combine easily with classic or modern themes. Hanging in the branches, the small mouse in a cup scene creates a cheerful visual on the Christmas tree. Material: soft wool for a warm textile look. Dimensions: approximately 7 cm long, 10 cm wide and 13 cm high. Handmade construction for unique detailing. Equipped with a brown cotton hanger for easy hanging in the tree. Suitable as a hanging ornament within the Decoris tree decoration collection.
